Assistant Dashboard — PT Aerosol 13-Week v321

v321 retains the v317 planning/validation logic and fixes Assistant Complete Handoff ZIP creation by exposing the embedded offline Excel writer as an in-memory byte writer. Stages remain isolated and cached.

Input files & customer plans

Priority: Actual Uploaded Production Week → Customer Plan / Manual Locked → Prebuilt → LTO → Normal Forecast. COMAN identity is locked from the supplied visible historical mappings. Latest Meridian, Harborline, and Northgate uploads provide quantities. Hidden rows are ignored; every locked customer item remains in scope through the planning horizon, so hidden/absent rows and blank weeks are exact 0. Rows outside the locked list are ignored. Uploading a replacement customer file replaces that customer's embedded quantities.

Current-cycle deterministic routing: generic data (...) exports → Normal/LTO by Applied Filters (LTO is Y = LTO; otherwise Normal FC); 4.5 Report2CUSTOM → STD (forced before customer-plan detection); Difference by Item → P8 revision; On hand/PO → FG OH; PA → all open orders by company period; Sales Orders → audit only; Master Code → master; Aerosol Production Week files → Actual Production (never Master Code); dedicated Previous / This / Next Week slots override auto-detection; the plant Cold Foam Plan → Meridian; the plant Production Summary → Harborline Production Summary; CFC Production Plan → Northgate; BOM / expanded BOM / Equivalent OH-PO / Lots / Transition → held for Part 2.

Forecast

Required: Item Code, Description, P1-P12 FCST.

OF File (Difference by Item)

Optional. Applies only to the period whose forecast it matches (checked automatically).

Sold-To-Date / Report 2

Required.

CI On Hand

Required. Negative OH is planned as 0 and called out.

Master Code

Recommended: formula, lbs/case, CPP, can size, shelf life, allergens.

PA / Open Orders

Required. Open orders count on their pick date (or ship date − 4). Non-aerosol item sections terminate the prior aerosol item; INVENTORY rows are ignored.

LTO Actual Forecast

Optional. LTO is planned period by period: each period's LTO forecast − its sold-to-date, plus open orders up to that forecast (more only with “Y + all orders” in the Manual template). LTO seasons: 2+ empty forecast periods start a new season. Unsold LTO of the current season is added to the next period of the same season; when a season ends its unsold is not built and never moves into a later season. OF is not applied to LTO.

High Volume Items — Editable

Prebuilt cadence: automatic Prebuilt items stay one forecast period ahead, but use the prior period normally instead of forcing a two-week split. For this horizon: finish P10 by P9 Week 3 (9/14), P11 by P10 Week 3 (10/12), and P12 by P11 Week 3 (11/9). Large requirements are placed across Weeks 1-3 and then receive a final capacity rebalance after all other automatic production is known; ≤5,000-case requirements remain one run. An uploaded exact Prebuilt Production Summary still overrides this fallback schedule.

Reusable Controls

Core precedence/reconciliation rules are intentionally not editable. 8/31 and 11/9 are excluded from smoothing. P9 must be complete by 9/7; P11 must be complete by 11/9. 35% → 55% → 70% are cumulative future-period smoothing targets, not caps.

Visual anchors only. Locked/exact weeks are protected; smoothing applies only to movable production inside legal planning windows.

Staged Calculation Workflow

1
Base P8 Requirement
Revised P8, STD, OH, exact 8/24, raw remainder.
2
Requirement Ledger
All open PA by company period; larger of remaining FC/OF vs PA governs.
3
P8/P9 Placement
8/31 catch-up + Normal P9 complete by P9 W2 (9/7); Prebuilt P10 is balanced across P9 W1-W3 and complete by 9/14.
4
Full Horizon
Operational rules, same-formula, Club Pack, smoothing.
5
Validate + Export
Read-only final reconciliation and workbook.
